ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, it demonstrates the principle of pinhole imaging, where $OA=30\,cm$, $OC=10\,cm$, and $AB\parallel CD$. If the height of the object $AB$ is $15\,cm$, what is the height of the image $CD$ in $cm$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since AB $\parallel$ CD,\\
therefore $\frac{OA}{OC}=\frac{AB}{CD}$,\\
thus $\frac{30}{10}=\frac{15}{CD}$,\\
therefore CD = \boxed{5} cm.
